problem_statement: codrops/ProductComparison is a static HTML/CSS/JS Blueprint demo: a responsive wine catalog grid (twelve bottles) with a fixed compare basket, add-to-compare checkboxes, and a full-screen comparison overlay driven by vanilla JS (js/main.js, js/classie.js). The catalog page (index.html) renders a 'Comparison readiness' summary strip (four tiles: bottles in cellar, regions covered, compare slots, price range) above the grid, and the site now spans three pages that share the Blueprint header and nav: the catalog, a 'Saved comparisons' page (compare.html) and a 'Cellar buying guide' page (guide.html). Complete and repair the comparison experience so it is consistent, responsive, visually on-brand, and actually wired: (a) add a shared 'Cellar readiness' summary bar (class 'readiness-bar') under the header of EVERY page (catalog, saved comparisons, cellar buying guide) so the readiness summary is reachable site-wide, styled to match the Blueprint look; (b) fix css/readiness-strip.css so the 'Comparison readiness' tile row no longer overflows the 390px mobile viewport (let the tiles wrap / use a fluid row instead of a fixed-width non-wrapping row; do not merely clip it with overflow-x:hidden); (c) keep the readiness strip and bar visually faithful to the Blueprint palette (dark #24252A tiles, blue #797BED accents, white values), not a collapsed off-palette restyle; and (d) wire js/readiness.js so that ticking a product's add-to-compare checkbox updates the shared readout ('#readyCount', 'N of 3 selected') in the header, not merely mark the element touched. Preserve the Blueprint identity, header, nav, the twelve-product grid, the compare basket, and the comparison overlay.
required_content: Add a shared 'Cellar readiness' summary bar (class 'readiness-bar', containing the text 'Cellar readiness') under the Blueprint header of ALL THREE pages (index.html, compare.html, guide.html) so the readiness summary appears consistently site-wide, not only on the catalog.

Fix css/readiness-strip.css so the 'Comparison readiness' tile row has NO horizontal overflow at 390px mobile width (wrap the tiles / fluid row). Do not clip the overflow with overflow-x:hidden; the document itself must not exceed the mobile viewport width (tolerance 24px).

Keep the desktop (1440px) and tablet (834px) layouts free of horizontal overflow, and keep all four readiness tiles and their labels/metric values ('12 wines', '9 regions', 'Up to 3', '$15.90 to $269.00') rendered on every state.

Style the readiness strip and the shared bar to match the Blueprint look (dark #24252A tiles/bar, blue #797BED / #5C5EDC accents, white metric values) — the rendered strip/bar must be visually faithful to the reference, not a collapsed or off-palette (bright amber/tan) restyle.

Wire js/readiness.js so that ticking a product card's add-to-compare checkbox updates the shared readout '#readyCount' to '1 of 3 selected', '2 of 3 selected', ... in the Blueprint header — the post-interaction terminal state must reflect the selection, not stay at '0 of 3 selected'.
Do not damage the existing Blueprint header/nav, the twelve-product grid, the compare basket, the comparison overlay behaviour, or the local product imagery on any page.
design_constraints: Preserve the Blueprint identity: the 'Blueprint' wordmark and 'Product Comparison Layout & Effect' heading, the dark editorial surface, the compare basket, the twelve-product wine grid, and the comparison overlay.
Do not replace the pages, the product grid, or the readiness strip with a new app shell, modal-only interface, external design system, or unrelated layout.
Do not remove the readiness strip, the shared readiness bar, the add-to-compare checkboxes, the #readyCount readout, the nav, product cards, or overlay.

Do not add npm dependencies, remote scripts, remote fonts, remote images, generated build outputs, or unrelated file churn; the fix stays in css/readiness-strip.css, js/readiness.js and the shared bar markup.
The readiness tile row and the shared bar must fit within 1440px desktop, 834px tablet, and 390px mobile viewports without horizontal overflow, and must render in the Blueprint dark/blue palette.
state_constraints: desktop_home loads the catalog at 1440px: the comparison readiness strip renders its four tiles with no horizontal overflow.
tablet_home checks the same catalog at 834px with no horizontal overflow.
mobile_home checks the same catalog at 390px and MUST have no horizontal overflow (this is the repaired behaviour; the buggy baseline overflows here).
desktop_selected checks the first two products' compare checkboxes so the compare basket becomes active; the strip content is unchanged.
desktop_compare opens the comparison overlay after selecting two products; the strip content is unchanged.
mobile_selected checks two products at 390px and MUST have no horizontal overflow after the basket activates.

change_completion: The shared 'Cellar readiness' bar appears under the header of all three pages (catalog, saved comparisons, cellar buying guide).
The mobile catalog has no horizontal overflow after the readiness-row repair, and all four tiles stay rendered.
Ticking a product's add-to-compare checkbox updates the shared '#readyCount' readout to '1 of 3 selected'.
design_consistency: The readiness strip and shared bar keep the Blueprint dark #24252A + blue #797BED palette and are visually faithful to the reference.
The same readiness bar component is consistent across all three pages; the header, grid, and overlay remain visually recognizable.
regression: Catalog, saved-comparisons, and cellar-guide pages retain the Blueprint wordmark, heading, nav, and product imagery.
No new dependency, remote asset, generated build artifact, or broad redesign is introduced; the static demo still serves without a custom dev server.
responsive: The catalog has no horizontal overflow on the 390px mobile states (mobile_home / mobile_readiness / mobile_selected).
Desktop and tablet states remain free of horizontal overflow and the tiles reflow and stay readable at 390px.

metadata.selected_repo_reason: codrops/ProductComparison is a runnable static HTML/CSS/JS product-comparison catalog whose main view now hosts a comparison readiness summary strip. A fixed-width no-wrap tile row in that strip overflows the 390px mobile viewport, making it an ideal implementation_continuity Repair task: the reference lets the row wrap so mobile overflow is 0, the buggy baseline keeps the fixed row and overflows, and a shallow overflow-x:hidden non-fix still overflows the content right-edge.

author_notes: Repo-grounded Repair task on the static codrops ProductComparison wine catalog, HARDENED to L4 with four orthogonal discriminator gates. The graded surface is one stylesheet (css/readiness-strip.css), one interaction script (js/readiness.js), and the readiness-bar placement across three pages (index.html catalog + manufactured compare.html 'Saved comparisons' and guide.html 'Cellar buying guide', all sharing the Blueprint header/nav). Reference: the 'Comparison readiness' tile row wraps (flex-wrap:wrap + flex:1 1 150px) so mobile overflow is 0; the shared 'Cellar readiness' bar appears on all three pages; the strip/bar keep the Blueprint dark/blue palette; and readiness.js updates the '#readyCount' readout on every add-to-compare change. Baseline is the buggy original (fixed-width 760px no-wrap tile row) which overflows the 390px mobile viewport (+390px) and, lacking the shared bar and the amber restyle, also drifts visually on the mobile readiness state — it FAILS no_horizontal_overflow, visual_regression and the cross-page dom_assertions, but its readiness.js wiring is CORRECT so it PASSES the interaction gate. The known-bad control is a plausible-but-wrong fix that (1) narrows the row to 560px and adds overflow-x:hidden but leaves a no-wrap row wider than the phone (+190px overflow persists), (2) restyles the strip/bar to a collapsed bright-amber off-palette (block-color delta ~69, pixel diff 0.089) that is text-correct but visually broken, (3) adds the shared bar to the catalog and saved-comparisons pages but forgets the cellar-guide page (cross-page dom_assertion fails on desktop_guide_page), and (4) marks the readout element data-touched on click (so the click 'runs' and action_history passes) but never re-renders '#readyCount', leaving the readout stale at '0 of 3 selected' — so it FAILS FOUR gates (no_horizontal_overflow, visual_regression, dom_assertions, interaction_assertions). Content and DOM are byte-identical to the reference on the catalog grid; the remote Google Fonts @import and remote Font Awesome CDN are vendored to a local subset (declared build infrastructure, identical across all three legs), so all three legs are console/network clean with 0 ambient overflow.
